title: Dell joins Nscale's $1.1B Series B

sources.quote: The financing was led by Aker ASA, with continued support from existing shareholders, including Sandton Capital, and participation from Blue Owl Managed Funds, Dell, Fidelity Management & Research Company, G Squared, Nokia, NVIDIA, Point72 and T.Capital.

explain: Server maker Dell invested an undisclosed amount in Nscale's $1.1 billion Series B. Dell sells AI servers to neoclouds like Nscale, so it is backing a customer.
